new_value: Fixed and pinned. validate_ipv6_transport_lengths (lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_helpers.c) is now self-defending: version != 6 -> SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE immediately after the pkt_len >= IPV6_HDR_LEN guard, mirroring the internal version checks of Rust validate_full_ipv6_structure (codec.rs:272-277) and Python IPv6Header.from_bytes (packet.py:107-115). Production behavior unchanged: the sole caller lichen_schc_compress pre-gates version at schc.c:542, so the new check is unreachable-false there and the check can only make the validator stricter. Pinned by a new direct-call unit test test_validator_direct_call_self_defense in lichen/tests/schc/main.c (includes schc_internal.h; the test target already links the private include dir): (a) 4-byte truncated buffer rejects without OOB - regression guard for the latent stack read tracked by nyx7; (b) 40-byte version-4 buffer with chain-terminating NH 59 rejects - a DISCRIMINATING fixture (pre-uylk code returned SCHC_OK via the non-UDP terminal path, so a revert of the self-check fails the test; both correctness and edge reviewer passes independently converged on this fixture requirement after my initial {0x45} fixture proved vacuous - the old fixture was rejected by the ext-header chain walk regardless of the version check); (c) minimal version-6 header {[0]=0x60,[6]=59} returns SCHC_OK - over-strictness guard; (d) valid 59-byte CoAP linklocal returns SCHC_OK. Gates on heft: C host schc suite 16/16 (clang, ASan/UBSan); C schc_parity 51 vectors PASS (parity outcomes unaffected - compress-side non-IPv6 vectors reject at the pre-existing schc.c gate before the validator runs); cppcheck clean. Codereview 3x per step 4 (reviewer model): correctness kimi-k3 - one finding (vacuous version4 fixture), fixed; edge-cases kimi-k3 - same finding via mutation analysis (mutant: delete the self-check, test still passes with the old fixture - survived; new fixture kills the mutant), no others; security: claude-opus-4-5 down (err_9d442af7 - 5th opus failure today) so kimi-k3 fallback per protocol - PASS (no OOB: packet[0] read only after the length guard; stricter-only; discriminating pin confirmed; positive controls verified with an independent RFC 1071 oracle). This also lands the direct-call coverage nyx7's close was waiting on; nyx7's own OOB guard has been in place at schc_helpers.c:465-467 since the njdx-era work.
